_about: Every public-domain Jeremiah Burroughs (1599-1646) text the Word Hoard holds. Burroughs has no collected Works. Two Nichol's Series reprints carry the most text (the Exposition of Hosea, 1863, with the continuations by Thomas Hall and Edward Reynolds; The Saints' Happiness, 1867); the rest survive on IA only in 1640s-1650s printings, whose old type OCRs badly. All raw IA OCR, unconverted. CCEL has no Burroughs (ccel.org/ccel/burroughs returned 404 on 2026-10-02) and Gutenberg has none.

burroughs-hosea-1863: An Exposition of the Prophecy of Hosea, with continuations by Thomas Hall and Edward Reynolds (Edinburgh: James Nichol, 1863)
burroughs-saints-happiness-1867: The Saints' Happiness: Lectures on the Beatitudes (Edinburgh: James Nichol, 1867)
burroughs-moses-choice-1650: Moses his Choice, with his Eye Fixed upon Heaven (London, 1650)
burroughs-four-books-matthew-1659: Four Books on the Eleventh of Matthew (London, 1659)
burroughs-rare-jewel-1649: The Rare Jewel of Christian Contentment (London, 1649 printing)
burroughs-irenicum-1653: Irenicum, to the Lovers of Truth and Peace (London, 1653; EEBO scan)
burroughs-saints-treasury-1656: The Saints' Treasury: Sundry Sermons (London, 1656 printing; EEBO scan)
burroughs-glorious-name-1643: The Glorious Name of God, the Lord of Hosts: Two Sermons (London, 1643; EEBO scan)
